posts.text: Company received 387cr as part of CGFMU insurance claim. NNPA down to 170 cr from 542 cr Out of the 170cr, 134 is claimable under CGFMU in future. PAT growth more than 100% from 35 to 75cr. On track to double pat in fy27 from fy26 levels as per management indication Advances and deposit growth healthy at around 30%. The cycle is turning and good days seem to be ahead for the micro finance industry. Disclosure: Invested as part of micro finance basket along with Arman, Jana, Northern Arc, Mas Fin and Satin
